text: On C.D. Broad's growing block theory, the future and the present are real, while the past has ceased to exist.
explanation: The statement inverts the growing-block view. Broad's growing block holds that the past and present are real while the future is not yet real, with the present as the leading edge of an ever-accumulating block. The version described -- future and present real, past gone -- corresponds to no theory in the unit, so the statement is false.
